note: Built from the official trophy descriptions alone: which story chapters and missions, which collectibles and counts, in what order. No online trophies exist on this list — all 55 are offline single-player — so nothing here needs another player. The game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so the save advice in stage 1 is the whole safety net.

stages.advice: Play Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission in order. That alone earns all 12 story trophies: Gone Fishing, the four chapter trophies, the six named missions (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and the final mission. Before you start, learn the save rules: there is no mission replay, so keep one manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission, and rotate the rest. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.
stages.title: Play the story — and save at every chapter
stages.warning: In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter ends — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is gone afterwards. In Chapter 3, race Race Against Yago the moment it appears; it is time-sensitive and its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

stages.advice: Switching between Jason and Lucia opens during Chapter 2, and from then on you can call the other in as your partner. With your partner beside you: lose a 4-star Wanted Level and escape (Hot Together — easiest during a bank-vault job), rob 3 shops in a row without losing the Wanted Level (Retail Therapy), and train at the gym until both characters reach maximum Strength (Personal Best). Meditate at spots with your partner too — each outdoor spot should count twice, once per character, toward Positive Mental Attitude.
stages.title: Partner trophies — Jason and Lucia together

stages.advice: Finish the final mission for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — five side-story finales, all still available after the credits. Hunt the unique animal for Bret in his Jason-only questline. Alongside them, complete 8 stranger mission strands for Strangers & Freaks — but remember Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward the eight, because they have their own trophies, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.
stages.title: Side stories — the five finales and Bret's hunt

stages.advice: Robberies open up in Chapters 3 and 4. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun for jewelry-store robberies (Sneakthief — back door, safe code from the note inside, leave unseen). Near the end of Chapter 4 the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal — 5 vaults for the trophy, all 8 for 100%). Rob an armored truck (A Classic Blitz Play), one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs (Pest Control — 39 in all for 100%), and launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts (Dime on the Dollar). Spending $100,000 across all shops (Treat Yo Self) fills up as you gear up for all of this.
stages.title: Robberies — vaults, trucks, shops and gangs

stages.advice: Complete 3 collectible card sets (Don't Touch My Deck), check in with WAiNK at 100 locations (You WAiNKer!), discover 100 vehicles by scanning traffic with WAiNK (Whip It Good — 200 of 277 models for 100%), explore all 52 areas of Leonida (The Goodtime State), buy all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Little Boxes — about $160,000, and story-given garages do not count), and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app (On the Spot — the Chapter 2 mission Moses opens it; each car needs a free garage space). Finish the 18 meditation spots (Positive Mental Attitude) if the Chapter 1 balcony one is already done.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration

stages.advice: Work through the activity list: 250 stunts (300 for 100%), gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges, a Top Fun drone race win at each of the 14 locations, 20 different race wins, a fishing win over Cal, one finished arcade game, 50 Challenges (70 of 80 for 100%), 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, a plane stolen from a VCIA boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4), a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, a smash-out from a vehicle showroom, the Kingpin Bowling operation, and 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Try each of the 9 activity types once for Master of None. The cryptic trophies — Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin — have no confirmed trigger yet; let them pop while you play rather than chasing a guess.
stages.title: Activities and grinds

stages.advice: After the credits, the 100% checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Everything you did earlier already counts. Close the gaps the checklist names — the known ones are 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations — and A Long Road (gold) pops at 100%. The moment it does, the platinum Vice Got a Price! follows: you are a Leonida Legend.
stages.title: Cleanup — 100% and the platinum
